programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programme.title: The Killer's Game
programme.desc: Joe Flood, one of the best contract killers, learns about an incurable disease and places a contract on himself.However, the murderess is targeting his ex-girlfriend.Joe decides to save her.

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: Clover and her friends go to the valley where her sister disappeared.They become the target of a murderer.Their story repeats itself every morning.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Knife
programme.desc: A year ago, teenage Winnie Carruthers (Jane Widdop) had to face a psychopathic murderer, Henry Waters (Justin Long), on Christmas Eve, whose victim was also her best friend.Now it's Christmas again in the town of Angel Falls.Winnie still remembers the tragic events, although her father David (Joel McHale) and other loved ones advise her to leave the difficult past behind.A misunderstood girl on a bridge on Christmas night makes a wish - she would prefer to have never been born.He then finds himself in a nightmarish parallel universe.He discovers that without her, everything could have turned out much worse.No one recognizes her here, she is a stranger even to her family and friends.And what's worse, Henry is still alive and the mayor of Angel Falls.The teenager must regain her former life and face a bloodthirsty murderer.A bloody variation on the famous Christmas classic - "It's a Wonderful Life" by Frank Capra.

programme.title: Hail Mary
programme.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie
programme.desc: A flock of colorful flightless birds lives on a quiet, exotic island.In this paradise community, there is no shortage of outsiders, such as the hot-tempered Red, the quick-as-the-wind Chuck, and the explosive Bomb.Unexpectedly, their happiness is interrupted by the appearance of mysterious green pigs.The picture impresses with its refined animation.Full of humor and positive energy, the production, whose plot refers to the popular smartphone game "Angry Birds", will appeal to both younger and older viewers.The film was directed by two debutants: Clay Kaytis and Fergal Reilly;and in the Polish version you can hear the voices of, among others:Jacek Bończyk, Janusz Zadura, Piotr Bąk and Marta Dobecka.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: The colorful flock of flightless birds and the cunning green pigs continue to quarrel and cannot stand each other's presence.Unexpectedly, however, they have to call a truce and forget about their disagreements.Their islands are threatened by a completely new enemy, whom they can only defeat by fighting side by side.Red, Bomba, Chuck and his sister Silver get along with Leonard and his crew.The second film inspired by a popular smartphone game.In the Polish language version, the voices were: Jacek Bończyk (Red), Agnieszka Mrozińska (Silver), Janusz Zadura (Chuck), Piotr Bąk (Bomba), Paweł Szczęsny (Leonard).

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
programme.desc: Harry Potter and his friends, Hermione and Ron, are starting their sixth year at Hogwarts.Magic school is no longer a safe place.The teaching staff is changing.Horace Slughorn becomes a potions teacher, and Severus Snape conducts Defense Against the Dark Arts classes.Meanwhile, Harry, supported by Albus Dumbledore, tries to learn about Lord Voldemort's dark past.The new professor can help with this, but he does not want to admit the mistake he made many years ago.Potter borrows a mysterious textbook that formerly belonged to the Half-Blood Prince.Thanks to the previous owner's notes there, he becomes top student in Potions classes.At the same time, he is preparing for a fight with the Dark Lord.Together with Dumbledore, he searches for horcruxes - magical objects in which Voldemort locked pieces of his soul.However, Harry does not know that his powerful enemy has a spy at Hogwarts.He was given a task by Voldemort.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: After an insidious attack by the Harkonnens and the death of his father, Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) and his pregnant mother, Jessica (Rebecca Ferguson), hide in the desert among the Fremen.There, a young man's feelings for Chani (Zendaya) sprout.At the same time, he matures spiritually.The leader of the wandering people, Stilgar (Javier Bardem), closely observes the only descendant of the Atreides family and becomes convinced that he is the chosen one, whose coming has been predicted for generations.However, to be accepted by the Fremen, Paul must pass the ultimate test by riding a monstrous worm.Meanwhile, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen (Stellan Skarsgard) finds out that Paul is alive.He knows he has to hurry.He decides to take control of the entire planet Arrakis.He starts launching attack after attack.A continuation of the spectacular production from 2021, which was awarded six Oscars.Both films are adaptations of the famous science fiction novel by Frank Herbert.

programme.title: F+
programme.desc: A family comedy aimed at teenagers.Ted (Wells Rappaport) and Josh (James Williams Jr.) are best friends and go to the Magnet School for Math and Science together.Ted is a star student, and Josh specializes in creating gadgets that they then use to prank others.After one of such antics, they are suspended.They must be careful because the next time will result in expulsion from school.The situation becomes more complicated when they fail the most important exam.The same fate befell Penny (Lily Jane), Ted's rival.Convinced that something was wrong with the test itself, they team up with a magician and a hacker to try to destroy the results at a school dance and give themselves a chance to improve.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The supporting penguin agents known from the three parts of "Madagascar" return to the cinema screen in their own production.Great entertainment for younger and older viewers guaranteed.Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private engage in a mission on which the fate of the world depends.They must face the geneticist Oktawiusz Mackiewicz, who dreams of controlling the Earth.In fact, the enemy of flightless birds is a vengeful octopus.It intends to settle accounts with visitors from Antarctica.Penguin agents join forces with the secret organization North Wind, which includes: the Greenland seal Detonator, the muscular teddy bear Kapral and the snowy owl Ewa.They are commanded by the mysterious Arctic Wolf, the Covert Agent.Good company awakens the competitive spirit in Skipper.As befits real superspies, the flightless unit travels halfway around the world.He visits, among others:Venice, Antarctica, Shanghai and New York.

programme.title: What Happens Later
programme.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Yorkshire.Catherine Earnshaw (Margot Robbie) begins a love relationship with the stray Heathcliff (Jacob Elordi), taken in by her father.The forbidden feeling has a destructive effect on both of them.

programme.title: G20
programme.desc: During the G20 summit, the leaders of the world's influential countries become the targets of terrorists.US President Danielle Sutton (Viola Davis) miraculously manages to escape the attackers.She must face the enemy alone.

programme.title: Vinci 2
programme.desc: Cuma receives an offer to participate in a new heist.At first he refuses, but changes his mind when he learns that his old rival, Chudy, is planning a spectacular robbery in Krakow without his participation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Teenage Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), from New Jersey to Los Angeles.He becomes friends with his peer Tommy (Rob Garrison).During a beach party, the boy meets a nice blonde, Ali (Elisabeth Shue).The two immediately take a liking to each other, which does not please her ex-boyfriend, Johnny (William Zabka).As an excellent karateka, he easily teaches his rival a lesson.Humiliated, Daniel also decides to start training eastern martial arts to defeat the enemy.Unfortunately, he cannot join the local club because Johnny and his equally unpleasant and brutal friends practice there.One evening, Daniel is attacked by them again.He is saved from trouble by an old man, Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), who turns out to be a master of eastern martial arts.From then on, the teenager learns the secrets of karate under his watchful eye.The Japanese teaches him not only the fighting style, but also a lot about life... A perfect film for karate lovers.For his role as Master Noriyuki "Pat" Morita, he received an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor and a Golden Globe nomination.Director of photography John G. Avildsen is known as the creator of the legendary "Rocky" from 1976 with Sylvester Stallone.

programme.title: Little Emma
programme.desc: A little girl named Emma was raised by animals.Her life is full of warmth and joy until one of her friends discovers the unpleasant truth that she was actually adopted and is not part of their family.Devastated, Emma sets out on a journey to find her loved ones.Along the way, he gathers an extraordinary team, including the clumsy inventor Żółwik Bystrzak, the ambitious scientist Edward Wilk and the brave Weasel Sancho.Together they are looking for a mysterious island which, according to legend, is inhabited by tiny people.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
programme.desc: After Dumbledore's death, Harry does not return to Hogwarts.He also breaks up with Ginny.Together with Hermione and Ron, he has to complete a mission entrusted to them by the deceased professor.Magic adepts must find horcruxes - mysterious objects in which Voldemort hid parts of his soul.Dumbledore left them things that could help them with their task.Unfortunately, they have no idea how to use them.At the same time, Harry tries to find out what the mysterious Deathly Hallows are that the Dark Lord is looking for.Without the support of mentors, he must rely on his friends more than ever.Meanwhile, the Ministry of Magic and Hogwarts fall under Voldemort's power.The school is now run by his right-hand man, Severus Snape.This means danger for students who do not come from wizarding families.Potter, Hermione and Ron must hide from Death Eaters.Soon Ron leaves his friends for unknown reasons.Harry and Hermione continue their journey alone.They go to Godric's Hollow, where the Potters lived.

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie (Katie Corwin) and Delaney (Delaney Buffett), who have known each other since childhood, are best friends.They cannot live without each other, even though each of them is at a different stage of their lives.While the first woman is ready to start a family, which was preceded by accepting the proposal of her boyfriend, John (Mason Gooding), the second one stopped at the college stage and has no intention of growing up.In addition, Delaney does not like her friend's boyfriend because she is convinced that sooner or later their relationship will suffer because of him.Therefore, Katie, who always takes into account her friend's opinion, decides to tell her about the engagement in the most delicate way possible, during a girls' trip together.Unfortunately, nothing goes according to plan during the trip.Katie Corwin and Delaney Buffett, who play the main characters, and who also co-wrote the film's script, are also considered best friends in real life.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) are like lovebirds, they have been friends for years and share an apartment.Their everyday lives suddenly turn upside down when they discover that Alyssa's boyfriend has squandered all their savings - money that was supposed to be used to pay the rent.The girls face a real challenge: in an atmosphere full of funny adventures, they must quickly find a way to get the missing amount and avoid eviction.It quickly turns out that they will be forced to take truly unusual actions to not only save their home, but also put their friendship to the test.

programme.title: You Gotta Believe
programme.desc: A group of baseball players are having the most important season of their lives.For one of the boys, the stakes are even higher - the team fights not only for victories, but also for his father's dream to come true.

programme.title: Another Simple Favor
programme.desc: Emily Nelson (Blake Lively), who was sentenced to 20 years in prison, regains her freedom.She is planning a wedding on the island of Capri, and an old friend becomes her bridesmaid.A crime occurs during the ceremony.

programme.title: A Working Man
programme.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.
